---
title: "Troubleshooting"
subtitle: "The errors that actually happen"
---

Find your symptom below. If it is not here, see [Still
stuck?](#still-stuck) at the bottom.

## Installing

### The installer will not run, or asks for a password

You do not have administrator rights on this laptop.

**Do this:** ask your IT department to install R, RStudio and Quarto. Send them
[Step 1](../prelude/install.qmd). Do it this week.

### RStudio says R is not installed, but it is

RStudio looks for R when it starts, and it was probably installed before R was.

**Do this:**

1. Close RStudio.
2. Open R on its own and confirm it works.
3. Install RStudio again.
4. If it still fails, open RStudio and click **Tools → Global Options →
   General**, then **Change**, and choose your R by hand.

### `quarto: command not found`, or Quarto is missing after you installed it

Quarto adds itself to your system PATH. Programs already running cannot see
that change.

**Do this:** restart the whole computer, not only RStudio. Then run
`quarto::quarto_version()` in the Console.

### The check says Quarto is installed but the `quarto` R package is not

These are 2 separate things with the same name.

**Do this:** run `install.packages("quarto")` in the Console.

## Installing packages

### The install stops part way through

**Do this:** run the install line again. It installs only what is still
missing, so it picks up where it stopped.

```r
source("https://drarunmitra.github.io/iisc-epi-shortcourse/setup/install_packages.R")
```

### R asks `Do you want to install from sources the package which needs compilation?`

**Do this:** type `n` and press **Enter**. Installing from source needs a
compiler you probably do not have, and the ready-made version is fine for this
course.

### `cannot open URL` or `unable to access index for repository`

Your network is blocking CRAN, or you are behind a proxy.

**Do this:**

1. Try a phone hotspot.
2. If that works, the problem is your institutional network. Tell your IT
   department that CRAN is blocked.
3. If nothing works, you can still do all 9 primers, because they need only a
   web browser. Tell us and we will pair you with someone on the first day.

### `there is no package called 'xyz'`

That package did not install, even though others did.

**Do this:** install it on its own so you can read its error.

```r
install.packages("xyz")
```

### The install works but `library()` fails with a version error

An old copy of the package is loaded in memory.

**Do this:** restart R with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd>,
then try again.

### `package 'xyz' was built under R version ...`

This is a warning, not an error. Your R is older than the package expects.

**Do this:** nothing, if the package loads. If it fails, install the current R.

## Paths and folders

### `cannot open file 'something.csv': No such file or directory`

R is looking somewhere other than where you think.

**Do this:**

1. Run `getwd()` and read what it prints.
2. Run `list.files()` and see what is actually there.
3. Move to the right folder, or give the full path.

### Files vanish, or a render fails at random

Your folder is inside OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive. The sync client
rewrites files while R is using them.

**Do this:** move your work to a folder on your local disk.

### Package installs fail with a path error on Windows

Your R was installed into a path containing spaces or non-English characters.

**Do this:** uninstall R and install it again into the default location.

## The browser primers

### The cells never become ready

Wait 2 or 3 minutes first. The page downloads about 17 MB before anything runs,
and Primer 5 downloads about 37 MB.

**If it still does not work:**

1. Try a phone hotspot. Institutional and hospital wifi often block this.
2. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
3. Turn off any ad blocker or script blocker for this site.
4. Use the [R primer reference](../prelude/r-primer.qmd) in RStudio instead.

### A cell runs and never stops

There is no Stop button.

**Do this:** reload the page. Everything on that page starts again from the
top.

### My answer looks right but the checker says no

Read the message under the cell. It names what is wrong.

Common causes: the wrong number of decimal places; a count where a proportion
was asked for; the right value reached the wrong way when the method was the
point of the exercise.

### My work disappeared when I moved to the next page

Each page runs its own R from scratch. Nothing carries between pages.

**Do this:** finish a page before you leave it.

## Rendering

### The render test in `check_setup.R` fails

R and Quarto are both installed but are not co-operating.

**Do this:**

1. Restart your computer.
2. Run `quarto::quarto_version()` in the Console. If it errors, run
   `install.packages("quarto")`.
3. Run the check again.

### The render works but produces no output file

Check that you are not rendering into a folder you cannot write to. Run
`getwd()` and confirm.

## Reading an error message

Most R errors name the function that failed and the reason. Read the last 2
lines first: the bottom of the message is usually the useful part.

| Message | Usually means |
|---|---|
| `could not find function "xyz"` | you forgot a `library()` line, or misspelled it |
| `object 'xyz' not found` | you have not created that object yet, or you misspelled it |
| `unexpected symbol` / `unexpected ')'` | a missing comma or an unclosed bracket, at or before that point |
| `undefined columns selected` | that column name does not exist; check `names(d)` |
| `argument "x" is missing, with no default` | a function needs an argument you did not give |
| `NAs introduced by coercion` | you tried to make numbers out of something that is not numeric |
| `$ operator is invalid for atomic vectors` | you used `$` on a vector; `$` works on tibbles and lists |

## Still stuck? {#still-stuck}

Email [office.msicph@iisc.ac.in](mailto:office.msicph@iisc.ac.in).

Include 3 things, every time:

- your operating system and its version;
- the exact error message, pasted as text rather than as a screenshot;
- the output of `sessionInfo()`.

**Paste text, not a picture.** A screenshot of an error cannot be searched,
cannot be pasted back to you as a fix, and is usually cropped one line above the
line that mattered.
